camera.timelapse_start_or_stop_cameras_and: Timelapse: start or stop (cameras and layout in Captures and timelapse)
camera.recording_timelapse_another_tap_stops_it: Recording timelapse. Another tap stops it.
camera.timelapse_stopped_the_video_is_built: Timelapse stopped: the video is built on the system (Captures and timelapse)
camera.this_camera_doesn_t_go_through: This camera doesn't go through the system relay: it can't be captured.
camera.capture_photo_with_date_job_and: Capture (photo with date, job and position)
camera.focus_hint: Turn the lens: the bar rises when the image is sharper. Stop at the peak.
camera.focus_cannot_measure: This camera does not allow measuring its image.
camera.focus_too_dark: Too dark to focus: turn on the flash.

common.settings_saved_on_the_system_they: Settings saved on the system (they apply to every screen).
common.name: Name

cameras.it_doesn_t_answer_as_an: It doesn't answer as an ESP32-CAM: used as a regular camera (no flash or settings).
cameras.asking_the_camera_whether_it_s: Asking the camera whether it's an ESP32 and has a flash...
cameras.flash_light_strip_help: The flash button turns the workshop light strip on and off (the camera has no LED of its own).
cameras.go_through_the_system_relay_several: Go through the system relay (several screens, captures and timelapse)
cameras.no_flash_detected_the_viewer_doesn: No flash (detected): the viewer doesn't show the button.
cameras.it_s_an_esp32_camera_flash: It's an ESP32-CAM (flash and image settings)
cameras.for_photo_mode_lightweight_empty_worked: For photo mode (lightweight). Empty: worked out for ESP32-CAM; if there is none, it shows video only.
cameras.the_address_has_to_start_with: The address has to start with http://
cameras.address_of_the_camera_stream_esp32: Address of the camera stream (ESP32-CAM: http://<ip>:81/stream). Changing it cuts the video for a few seconds on every screen.
cameras.direct_without_the_relay_no_captures: direct, without the relay (no captures or timelapse)
cameras.the_list_is_the_same_on: The list is the same on every screen; the one shown is per screen. Any camera with an MJPEG stream (ESP32-CAM, IP camera, mjpg-streamer, motion...).
cameras.saved_the_relay_reads_the_new: Saved: the relay reads the new camera (screens reconnect by themselves).
cameras.could_not_ask_relay_off: Could not ask (system relay off?): {error}. It is saved as it is.
cameras.could_not_read_the_system_relay_error: Could not read the system relay: {error}
cameras.system_relay_port_shares_the_video: System relay (port {port}): shares the video with all screens.

service.tap_one_to_see_it_in: Tap one to see it in the viewer
service.none_yet_tap_the_viewer_s: None yet. Tap the viewer's capture button: it saves the photo with the date, the job and the position.
service.none_yet_tap_start_now_above: None yet. Tap "Start now" above, or turn on "Timelapse of every job" and it is built by itself when the next job ends.

timelapse.uses_the_cameras_and_layout_from: Uses the cameras and layout from Settings. Without a start time, it starts now and stops at the chosen time. Without a stop time, it keeps going until Stop or the maximum duration.
timelapse.scheduled_the_system_starts_and_stops: Scheduled. The system starts and stops it by itself, even if you close this page.
timelapse.choose_the_start_time_the_stop: Choose the start time, the stop time or both.
timelapse.of_video_the_video_is_built: of video. The video is built on the system when it ends (a few minutes).
timelapse.hold_still_at_the_end_for: Hold still at the end for
timelapse.smooth_light_changes_flicker_from_the: Smooth light changes (flicker from the laser or the room light)
timelapse.large_centered_the_video_pauses_for: Large, centered (the video pauses for a moment)
timelapse.name_and_date_at_the_start: Name and date at the start
timelapse.applies_to_manual_ones_and_to: Applies to manual ones and to each job: when reached, it stops and builds the video with what was recorded. It also stops if less than 2 GB is left free on the system.
timelapse.a_single_video_that_switches_from: A single video that switches from one camera to another every few seconds.
timelapse.all_at_once_in_a_grid: All at once in a grid, with the name of each one.
timelapse.each_camera_in_its_own_video: Each camera in its own video.
timelapse.with_a_single_camera_you_get: With a single camera you get one video of that camera. Choose 2 or more in Recording to build a mosaic or switch between them.
timelapse.date_and_time_written_on_each: Date and time written on each photo
timelapse.without_layers_by_hand_one_photo: Without layers (by hand): one photo every
timelapse.in_printing_jobs_it_takes_a: In printing jobs it takes a photo every time the layer changes (the part grows without jumps). Manual ones and laser or CNC jobs stay time based.
timelapse.by_hand_records_with_the_cameras: By hand: records with the cameras and the layout set below, with or without a job, until you tap Stop.
timelapse.stopped_the_video_is_built_on: Stopped. The video is built on the system and shows up below in a few minutes.
timelapse.from_the_current_job_it_ends: From the current job: it ends by itself when the job ends.
timelapse.started_by_hand_keeps_going_until: Started by hand: keeps going until you tap Stop.
timelapse.stops_by_itself_after_max: Stops by itself after {t} (maximum duration in the settings).
timelapse.free_space_on_the_system: Free space on the system: {gb} GB. With less than 2 GB it does not start and stops what is recording.
timelapse.scheduled_starts_and_stops: Scheduled: starts on {start} and stops on {end}.

settings.what_you_change_here_is_saved: What you change here is saved on top of the chosen profile. Choosing a profile clears the fine changes.
settings.switch_automatically_to_the_suggested_on: Switch automatically to the suggested one ("During cut" while laser cutting, "Balanced" the rest of the time)
settings.the_camera_isn_t_responding_off: The camera isn't responding (off or no WiFi): changes apply when it's back.
settings.small_light_image_for_weak_wifi: Small, light image, for weak WiFi or many screens watching.
settings.more_exposure_and_gain_some_noise: More exposure and gain. Some noise; the flash helps more.
settings.more_resolution_to_align_or_focus: More resolution to align or focus. Fewer frames per second.
settings.less_exposure_the_laser_dot_doesn: Less exposure: the laser dot doesn't burn out the image and the material is visible.
settings.good_smooth_image_for_everyday_use: Good, smooth image. For everyday use.
settings.1280x1024_very_slow_max: 1280x1024 (very slow; the maximum of this camera)
settings.the_camera_didn_t_respond_is_it_on: The camera didn't respond: {error}. Is it on?

orientation.auto_uses_the_vision_calibration_only: Auto uses the Vision calibration (only the camera calibrated there).
orientation.auto_as_seen_standing_in_front: Auto: as seen standing in front of the machine (X+ to the right, Y+ to the back).
orientation.auto_not_available: Auto not available: {error}. Use the manual setting.

gallery.the_system_is_building_the_edited: The system is building the edited video: it shows up in the list in a moment.
gallery.the_end_has_to_be_after: The end has to be after the start.
gallery.pause_the_video_where_you_want: Pause the video where you want to start or end and tap Start here / End here.
gallery.edit_creates_a_new_video_this: Edit (creates a new video; this one stays the same)
gallery.no_captures_take_them_in_record: No captures. Take them in Record > Capture now or with the viewer's capture button.
gallery.no_timelapses_they_re_recorded_in: No timelapses. They're recorded in the Record tab.
gallery.tap_each_checkbox_to_choose_several: Tap each checkbox to choose several.
gallery.could_not_read_the_system_relay: Could not read the system relay (port 8090).
gallery.saves_the_photo_with_the_date: Saves the photo with the date, job and position. They show up in Captures.
gallery.yes_starts_and_ends_on_its: yes, starts and ends on its own
gallery.the_last_saved_photo_of_each: The last saved photo of each camera. It updates with each new photo.
gallery.the_system_is_building_a_video: The system is building a video: it shows up in Videos when it's done.
gallery.timelapses_of_jobs_or_by_hand: Timelapses of jobs or by hand, captures with date and position, and where they are stored. Done by the System service.
gallery.where_and_how_much_is_stored: Where and how much is stored: Settings
gallery.the_count_or_space_limits_were: The count or space limits were exceeded. If you do nothing, they are deleted on the date of each one. Keep the ones you want to save (they won't be deleted automatically) or download them first.
gallery.kept_it_won_t_be_deleted: Kept: it won't be deleted automatically.
gallery.deleted_by_itself_on_unless_kept: Deleted automatically on {date} unless you keep it.

tlSettings.the_system_has_almost_no_free: The system has almost no free space: delete old videos or captures.
tlSettings.saved_on_the_system_for_every: Saved on the system, for every screen.
tlSettings.notify_if_a_camera_stops_responding: Notify if a camera stops responding
tlSettings.camera_photo_or_video_in_the: Camera photo or video in the notifications (which types and how: Activity page)
tlSettings.camera_photo_or_video_in_the_no_activity: Camera photo or video in the notifications
tlSettings.when_a_limit_is_exceeded_the: When a limit is exceeded, the oldest ones are marked for deletion: a phone notification arrives and you have that long to keep or download them. Kept items are never deleted automatically. With less than 2 GB free on the system nothing is recorded.
tlSettings.on_the_system_s_card_videos: On the system's card: videos in 0:/workshop/camera/timelapse and photos in 0:/workshop/camera/captures. View, download and delete them in Plugins > Timelapses and captures.
tlSettings.when_it_stops_the_system_joins_2: When it stops, the system joins the photos into an MP4 with these settings.
tlSettings.off_it_only_records_when_you: Off: it only records when you tap Start now.
tlSettings.timelapse_of_every_job_starts_and: Timelapse of every job (starts and ends with the job)
tlSettings.which_cameras_how_often_a_photo: Which cameras, how often a photo and until when.
tlSettings.the_system_service_the_camera_relay: The System service (the camera relay) does it with ffmpeg. It doesn't use Vision or OpenCV: it works even without Vision installed.
tlSettings.the_system_service_the_camera_relay_no_v: The System service (the camera relay) does it with ffmpeg.
tlSettings.the_video_shows_up_in_videos: The video shows up in Videos: watch, download, rename, trim or speed it up. The single photos are deleted; the video stays.
tlSettings.when_it_stops_the_system_joins: When it stops, the system joins the photos into an MP4 video with the speed, title card and layout you chose. It takes a few minutes and doesn't slow the machine.
tlSettings.while_it_runs_by_hand_or: While it runs (by hand, or on its own with each job if you turn that on), the system saves a photo from each chosen camera every few seconds.
tlSettings.the_current_value_is_more_than_gb: The current value is more than what is available on the system ({gb} GB).

main.opens_the_floating_viewer: Opens the floating viewer (can be dragged and resized). Closing it (here or with the panel's X) only stops requesting images on THIS screen: it doesn't stop the camera or the relay for anyone.
main.no_camera_address_check_the_list: No camera address: check the viewer's camera list
main.camera_this_screen_only_open: Camera (this screen only): open -- tap to close
main.camera_this_screen_only_tap_to_open: Camera (this screen only): tap to open

startup_camera.cameras_tip: At least one camera with its video address (or the camera of the system relay). Add them with "+ Add camera".
startup_camera.cameras_missing: There is no image. Add it with "+ Add camera".
startup_camera.address_tip: Tests the camera you are watching. If it does not answer: check that it is on, on the same network, and the address is right.
startup_camera.address_missing: No image will show. Check that it is on, on the same network and that the address is written correctly.
startup_camera.relay_tip: Shares the video with several screens and saves captures and timelapse. Only needed for the cameras that go through it.
startup_camera.relay_stopped: stopped (captures and timelapse do not work)
startup_camera.cameras_what: At least one camera added, with its video address.
startup_camera.cameras_for: The viewer and the Workbench show what it sees.
startup_camera.address_what: The address (URL) of the camera you are looking at.
startup_camera.address_for: It is tested to know whether the camera answers.
startup_camera.relay_what: A program of the Pi that shares the camera video with several screens and saves snapshots and timelapse.
startup_camera.relay_for: Only the cameras that go through it use it.
startup_camera.relay_missing: Those cameras will not show an image or save snapshots. If your cameras go direct, you do not need it.
startup_camera.g_captures_desc: The photos the capture button saves.
startup_camera.g_timelapse_desc: The video built from one photo every so often.
startup_camera.folder_tip: Where the system keeps captures and timelapses. It must be writable and have free space on the card.
startup_camera.folder_bad: cannot save there or no room left
startup_camera.folder_what: The folder on the card where captures and videos are kept.
startup_camera.folder_for: Every capture and every timelapse is saved there.
startup_camera.folder_missing: Captures and videos will not be saved. Free some space on the card (delete old captures or timelapses in the gallery).
startup_camera.stamp: Date and position on the photo
startup_camera.stamp_tip: Writes the date, the job and the head position on every capture. The Pi's Pillow library does it.
startup_camera.stamp_plain: missing: captures are saved without text
startup_camera.stamp_what: The text with the date, the job and the position written on each capture.
startup_camera.stamp_for: It tells you when and where each photo was taken.
startup_camera.stamp_missing: Photos are still saved, just without that text. Fix it by installing the Pillow library on the Pi (python3-pil).
startup_camera.ffmpeg_tip: The program that joins the photos into a video. Without it a timelapse cannot be built.
startup_camera.ffmpeg_none: not installed: no timelapse can be built
startup_camera.ffmpeg_what: The program of the Pi that turns the photos into a video.
startup_camera.ffmpeg_for: The timelapse uses it when it finishes.
startup_camera.ffmpeg_missing: Photos are taken but the video is not built. Install it on the Pi with: sudo apt install ffmpeg.
startup_camera.clock_tip: A Pi without internet at power-on can start with an old date. The names and text of the photos would carry the wrong date.
startup_camera.clock_wrong: the date looks old (check the Pi's clock)
startup_camera.clock_what: The date and time the Pi has.
startup_camera.clock_for: It is written in the name and in the text of every capture and timelapse.
startup_camera.clock_missing: Photos will carry the wrong date. Connect the Pi to the internet for a moment or set the time.

roles.no_permission: Your user is not allowed to see the camera. Ask an administrator to enable it for visitors.
roles.this_camera_cannot_capture: This camera can only be viewed: it does not support captures.
roles.proto_service_old: Update the service: it is older than this camera plugin.
roles.proto_plugin_old: Update the camera plugin: the service is newer.

studio.preview_hint: A real still of the camera with the framing and the color already applied: this is what the video will look like.
studio.preview_unavailable: The camera gave no picture to preview.
studio.presets_hint: One tap sets codec, framing, color and rate. Adjust afterwards.
studio.presets_saved_with_settings: Your presets are stored with the settings (Save).
studio.preset_cinema_hint: Widescreen crop, 23.976 fps, light shutter blend, fades and a touch of contrast.
studio.preset_prores_hint: ProRes HQ at the camera's size, 24 fps, keeps the stills. For DaVinci, Premiere or Final Cut.
studio.preset_dnxhr_hint: DNxHR HQ at the camera's size, 25 fps, keeps the stills. For Avid or Premiere.
studio.preset_draft_hint: Small and fast to build, to check the shot.
studio.capture_hint: How often a still is taken and what is kept.
studio.ramp_hint: The interval slides from the first value to this one along the time chosen and then stays there.
studio.stamp: Date and time on every still
studio.keep_frames: Keep the stills for the editor
studio.keep_frames_hint: A .zip with every still and frames.csv (frame, time) is saved next to the video. It takes space: it counts in the limit of the videos.
studio.framing_hint: Crop to a cinema format, choose the size and add a slow push.
studio.push_hint: The center of the picture drifts from the position above to this one while the zoom changes.
studio.color_hint: Applied to the whole video. The LUT goes first, then the sliders.
studio.lut_hint: 3D LUTs in .cube format, up to 6 MB. They are kept on the Pi.
studio.blend_hint: Averages neighbouring stills: moving things leave a soft trail like a longer exposure.
studio.delivery_hint: The file the editor will receive.
studio.title: Name and date at the start
studio.codec_edit_hint: Intermediate codec in a .mov: light to edit, big on disk. Tagged Rec.709.
studio.codec_web_hint: Small files in an .mp4, ready to share. Tagged Rec.709.
studio.estimate_hint: What an event gives with the settings above.
studio.est_limit: More than 20000 stills: the recording stops at that number.
studio.take_hint: Record now with these settings, without changing the saved ones.
studio.take_saved_hint: The saved settings are the ones used by jobs and by the Record tab.
studio.stabilize_hint: Smooths the shake between stills (a bumped tripod, wind). It works when each camera makes its own video, not in a mosaic or alternating.
studio.burst_hint: A series of photos in a row from the camera chosen in the preview. They appear in Captures.
studio.rebuild_hint: Builds a NEW video from the stills kept with an older one, with the settings on screen: other look, codec, speed or stabilization. The original stays.
studio.rebuild_none: No video kept its stills. Record with "Keep the stills for the editor" on to be able to rebuild it later.
studio.rebuild_started: Rebuilding. The new video appears in Videos when it is ready.

noCamera.title: No camera has been added yet
noCamera.body: Captures, timelapse and the Studio need a camera. Add one here and the system starts reading its video by itself: nothing is broken, there is just nothing to read yet.
noCamera.ask_technician: A technician has to add the camera. Ask them to open this page.
noCamera.address: Or type the address of the camera's video
noCamera.address_hint: For an ESP32-camera it looks like http://192.168.1.50:81/stream. Another camera gives its own MJPEG address.
noCamera.need_http: The address has to start with http:// or https://
noCamera.not_answering: Nothing answers at that address. Check it, or save it anyway if the camera is off right now.
noCamera.scan_prefix: Write the first three numbers of a private network, for example 192.168.1
noCamera.scan_found: {n} found. Tap one to use it.
noCamera.scan_none: No ESP32-camera answered in that network.
noCamera.picked: Address chosen. Now add the camera.
noCamera.scan_hint: It asks each address of the network for the camera's video port (81). It takes about 15 seconds. Only private networks are searched.
noCamera.next_1: Record a timelapse by hand, or take a photo, from the Record tab.
noCamera.next_2: In Settings, turn on a timelapse with every job so that each job is recorded by itself.
noCamera.next_3: The Studio tab sets the look of the video: format, color, codec.
